{{Historical content}} {{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Abandoned Cargo banner.png |location =[[Customs]] |given by =[[Therapist]] |reward = |previous = |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Terrible news, young man. I have stopped receiving communications from my group, and the documents you brought me have been scrubbed of all the essential information. We know neither the project code, nor the detailed itinerary. Not even a summary of these boxes' contents! I cannot possibly ask you to open them yourself. What if my group's demise has something to do with their contents? Instead, I came up with another idea. The documents said that in the event of obstacles along the transit, the delivery crews could opt to deviate from the route. If the movers were attacked during transit, we might learn about it from the workers' records. Examine the places where the delivery crews may have stayed and search for this information.}} ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Delivery crew report|delivery crew's shipment notes]] on [[Customs]] * Hand over the found [[Delivery crew report|information]] ==Rewards== * +10,300 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.02''' * 10,300 Roubles ** 10,815 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1 ** 11,845 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2 * 2× [[Portable defibrillator]] {{quote|Impossible... According to these records, no one attacked the movers, the path was clear! Yet the workers who spent several hours near the boxes reported itching and fever, and asked to go home. The foreman's notes say that two delivery crews abandoned the boxes during transportation and flatly refused to continue their work! It turns out that the transportation of these boxes required special protective equipment, which no one considered to provide to ordinary workers. It's unclear how dangerous the boxes are at the moment, but I wouldn't recommend approaching them without the appropriate equipment.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- |[[File:Delivery crew report icon.png|link=Delivery crew report]] |[[Delivery crew report]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |''This [[Quests#Quest items|quest item]] can only be found if the quest is active.''

''If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.'' |} In this quest you have to find the delivery crew's shipment notes on [[Customs]]. They can be found in the locker room on the first floor of the boiler building. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.
